data.one_liner: A high-level GitHub API Client Library for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It provides a client library for interacting with GitHub's v3 API across server, browser, and Flutter applications. It supports authentication, built-in OAuth2 flow, and a hook server helper.
use_when: You need to interact with the GitHub API from a Dart or Flutter application.
You want built-in support for GitHub authentication and OAuth2 flows.
avoid_when: You are looking for an official GitHub-maintained project.
You require complex caching or advanced offline storage layers out of the box.
strengths: Works across server, browser, and Flutter
Includes builtin OAuth2 flow and hook server helper
weaknesses: Not an official GitHub project (maintained by volunteers)
Limited to GitHub's API v3 scope primarily
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure authentication tokens or OAuth2 credentials as needed.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a powerful general-purpose HTTP client for REST requests instead of a specialized GitHub wrapper.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight, low-level HTTP client to implement custom GitHub API calls manually.
